notes: Phieu danh gia thang + Xuat Excel: filter/search/counter/dropdown chi nhanh chuyen sang dung TO CHUC HIEN TAI (current_branch/current_department/current_title, doc tu checklist_employee_assignments qua listMonthly()/exportMonthlyData()) thay vi snapshot dong bang tren checklist_monthly_forms.branch/department/title. Day la thay doi CACH TIM KIEM, khong phai nghiep vu: snapshot cua phieu, template/version, reviewer, diem, history, violation, evidence, notification giu nguyen 100%, khong ghi de, khong reconcile du lieu cu (case PHF076: snapshot branch van la Phu Loi, loc theo Ngo Quyen se thay vi current_branch=Ngo Quyen). Backend: listMonthly() (lib/checklist-monthly.js) them current_branch/current_department/current_title/current_employee_status/organization_mismatch/organization_source vao moi form, tai dung byCode map da co san (0 query them). exportMonthlyData() doi filter branch va search sang dung current org (them 1 query checklist_employee_assignments, khong N+1), file Excel giu ca 2 nhom cot: 'Chi nhanh/Phong ban tren phieu' (snapshot, khong doi) va them moi 'Chi nhanh/Phong ban hien tai'. Frontend: monthlyBranchSearchForms()/dropdown chi nhanh/dong Nhan su doi sang current_* (fallback ve snapshot neu nhan vien khong con assignment). Permission/quyen tham dinh KHONG doi - man Phieu danh gia thang la Admin-only (khong loc scope), quyen tham dinh cua Truong ca di qua monthlyReviewVisible()/getChecklistMonthlyReviewAccess() hoan toan doc lap, da dung current assignment tu truoc.
